summary: George County, MS fire tower about 6 miles NE of Lucedale; in place by 1942, its base was described as dismantled by 1971, and it is listed as removed.

facts.status_note: Listed as removed on the Forest Lookouts site. A 1971 survey note describes the base of the tower as dismantled; no removal date is given.

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey station, 108.73 ft SSW of a U.S.G.S. bench mark under the center of the Luce Fire Tower
Coast and Geodetic Survey recovery: marks found in good condition; station still described at the fire tower site
Mississippi State Highway Department recovery note describes the base of the tower as dismantled; the removal date is not given

notes_for_editor: Record coordinates (30.9535, -88.4886) agree with the NGS NAD 83 position (30 57 13.18581 N, 88 29 18.10221 W) to within about 30 m; no correction proposed. No source gives a build date, design, height, agency or removal date. The 1971 note says the tower was dismantled but gives no date, so the removal event's year is the first documented date, not the removal date. The NGS note names the leaseholder; the name is left out. Not on NHLR; FFLOS has no Mississippi entry for it. Story is about 130 words. Fixed 2026-10-21: the 1942 'bench mark under center' is the U.S.G.S. mark TT 16C 1940 (named in the 1958 and 1971 NGS notes); the C&GS station lies 108.73 ft SSW of it. The story now says so.
